skillExtracts.extract: name: watcher creator description: Guide for creating agent deck watchers conversationally. This skill should be used when users want to set up a new watcher (webhook, ntfy, github, slack, gmail) to route events to a conductor. It walks the user through selecting an adapter type, gathering required settings, generating watcher.toml and clients.json entries, and emits the exact agent deck watcher create command to run
